note_text: Huawei estimated shipments for the Ascend AI chip series were approximately 700,000 units in 2025. While 2026 projections reach 1.6 million silicon dies, this figure includes inventory and yield loss rather than millions of finished chips shipped. https://technode.com/2025/05/18/huawei-to-ship-700000-ascend-ai-chips-in-2025-despite-yield-challenges/ https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-09-29/huawei-to-double-output-of-top-ai-chip-as-nvidia-wavers-in-china
claim: Huawei shipped millions of AI chips in a recent year.
context:
But they do. What's the evidence? Huawei just had the largest single year in the history of their company.

Dwarkesh Patel

How many chips did they ship?

Jensen Huang

A ton. Millions. Millions is way more than Anthropic has.

source_verification.reasoning: Both sources directly support the note's claims: 700,000 units in 2025 (technode) and 1.6 million dies in 2026 (Bloomberg). The note's qualifier about inventory and yield loss is partially supported by Bloomberg's clarification that these are silicon dies, though the explicit 'inventory and yield loss' language comes from the IEEE ComSoc source not cited in the note. Still, the core factual claims are covered.

citations.quote: Huawei's Ascend AI chips, including the Ascend 910a, 910b, and 910c, are expected to reach 700,000 units in shipments by 2025
citations.explanation: Directly supports the note's 700,000 units in 2025 figure.

citations.quote: the Shenzhen-based company will raise output for its Ascend product line in 2026 to as many as 1.6 million dies, the people said, describing the basic silicon components that house chip circuitry
citations.explanation: Supports the 1.6 million dies in 2026 figure and notes these are silicon dies, not finished chips.
